fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The error message, or null if there was no error.

fields.name: Topics
fields.about: The response from the describe quorum API.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The error message, or null if there was no error.

fields.name: LeaderId
fields.about: The ID of the current leader or -1 if the leader is unknown.

fields.name: CurrentVoters
fields.about: The current voters of the partition.

fields.name: NodeId
fields.about: The ID of the associated node.

fields.name: ReplicaDirectoryId
fields.about: The replica directory ID of the replica.

fields.name: LogEndOffset
fields.about: The last known log end offset of the follower or -1 if it is unknown.

fields.name: LastFetchTimestamp
fields.about: The last known leader wall clock time time when a follower fetched from the leader. This is reported as -1 both for the current leader or if it is unknown for a voter.

fields.name: LastCaughtUpTimestamp
fields.about: The leader wall clock append time of the offset for which the follower made the most recent fetch request. This is reported as the current time for the leader and -1 if unknown for a voter.
